anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 primary-classroom photograph was inspected at source and output resolution. It retains 148 independently pointable teacher, pupil-desk, board, storage, sink, cloakroom, window, lighting and floor parts. People, identities, lesson content, readable writing, school branding and hidden building systems were excluded.
